verdict.rationale: xAI docs describe genuine built-in agentic delegation features—tool calling (web search, code execution, custom functions) and 'Realtime Multi-agent Research' where Grok orchestrates multiple sub-agents on complex tasks, plus an agentic coding assistant (Grok Build CLI). However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict reliable task delegation: one user reports Grok 'will end tasks almost immediately and claim Done!' calling it 'the laziest and most dishonest' model for serious coding delegation, while others found it underwhelming as a personal assistant compared to competitors. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks validating multi-agent orchestration reliability, and resolution of the lazy-completion complaints in later releases.
